The Orvik Commercial Dairy Framework

Three Pillars of Profitable Dairy Farming

In modern commercial dairy economics, long-term farm profitability depends on three scientific milestones: timely conception for 1 calf every year, reaching peak milk yield with persistent lactation, and surviving the critical transition phase without metabolic breakdown.

Pillar 1: Calf a Year ↓Pillar 2: Peak Milk Yield ↓Pillar 3: Transition Cow Health ↓
Pillar 01 • Reproductive Precision

Calf a Year (12-Month Calving Interval Target)

₹4,500+
Loss per missed heat cycle

Every dry day beyond the optimal 60-day dry period represents an outright net economic loss in feed, labor, and delayed lactation. Orvik's dual reproductive strategy combines UTRO-HEAL Liquid for rapid post-calving uterine cleansing and placenta release with TFS Powder (Metho-Chelated Minerals + Shatavari) to induce timely ovulatory estrus and ensure first-service conception.

Day 0: Calving

Uterine Evacuation

100ml Utro-Heal Liquid twice daily for 3-5 days to expel lochia & placenta.

Day 15 - 45

Metho-Mineral Loading

50g TFS Powder daily to restore Copper, Zinc MHA, Chromium & stimulate follicular waves.

Day 60 - 75

Strong Standing Heat

Clear stringy cervical mucus, overt behavioral estrus, and optimal follicle size.

Day 90: Conception

Pregnancy Confirmed

High conception rate on 1st insemination, achieving the 365-day calving target.

Pillar 02 • Lactation & Udder Health

Peak Milk Yield & Udder Keratinization

+200L to 250L
Total milk gained per 1L peak increase

For every single litre gain in peak daily milk yield, total 305-day lactation yield rises by 200 to 250 Litres! Orvik delivers double-strength chelated calcium in mango flavor (Chelated ORVICAL GOLD), concentrated bone-forming MCHC granules (ORVICAL-P), and 2000 mcg therapeutic Vitamin-H (UDDER-AYU) to expand udder capacity and stop mastitis before it starts.

Pillar 03 • Transition Cow Health

Smooth Transition (-21 to +21 Days) & Zero Milk Fever

10,000 mg
Elemental Calcium in Advance Gel

Over 75% of all dairy veterinary emergencies happen during the transition period (3 weeks before to 3 weeks after calving). Hypocalcemia leads to downer cow syndrome, displaced abomasum, and severe liver ketosis. Orvik safeguards your highest value dairy cows with immediate 10,000mg oral calcium gels, lipotropic liver protectors, and live probiotic microflora.

Acute Calving Drench

Advance ORVICAL Gel

300g squeeze tube delivering 10,000mg elemental calcium directly absorbed across oral mucosa into bloodstream.

Hepatic Lipotropic Guard

ORVI GUARD Tonic

Silymarin + Tricholine Citrate + Inositol to clear fatty liver infiltrations and restore energetic vigor.

Live Rumen Microflora

D-Yeast Powder

40 Billion CFU active live yeast (S. cerevisiae) to re-ignite volatile fatty acid (VFA) ruminal fermentation.
